title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Schedule of Deductible Options
content:
Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage (collision and comprehensive on one scheduled vehicle) is written at one of six deductible options. Each option fixes the deductible figures below for the vehicle that carries it.

## Deductibles by option (USD)

| Deductible option | Collision deductible | Comprehensive deductible (other than glass) | Glass repair deductible | Glass replacement deductible | Full glass included | Uninsured-driver collision deductible waiver carried |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Physical Damage $2,000 Deductible | 2000 | 1000 | 0 | 1000 | No | No |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible | 1000 | 1000 | 0 | 1000 | No | No |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $750 Deductible | 750 | 500 | 0 | 500 | No | Yes |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $500 Deductible | 500 | 500 | 0 | 500 | No | Yes |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $250 Deductible | 250 | 250 | 0 | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $100 Deductible | 100 | 100 | 0 | 0 | Yes | Yes |

## Terms common to every option

| Term | Every deductible option |
|---|---|
| Coverage part that pays for hitting an animal | Comprehensive |
| Deductible on a loss to a newly acquired vehicle during its automatic physical damage period (USD) | 500 |
| One deductible (the highest) when two or more vehicles on the same policy are damaged in one occurrence | Yes |

## Meaning of each column

- **Collision deductible** is the deductible figure of the option for a collision loss.
- **Comprehensive deductible** is the figure for a comprehensive (other than collision) loss other than glass.
- **Glass repair deductible** applies when damaged glass is repaired rather than replaced; **glass replacement deductible** applies when glass is replaced.
- **Full glass included** shows whether glass replacement carries no deductible on the option. On the two options marked Yes the glass replacement deductible is 0.
- **Uninsured-driver collision deductible waiver carried** shows whether the option carries the collision deductible waiver tied to an identified, uninsured other driver.

## Reading the schedule

- *Hypothetical:* a vehicle on the Cardinal Physical Damage $750 Deductible option has a windshield replaced. The glass replacement figure of that option is 500.
- *Hypothetical:* the same windshield is repaired instead. The glass repair figure is 0 on every option.
- *Hypothetical:* a vehicle on the Cardinal Physical Damage $250 Deductible option has glass replaced. Full glass is included on that option and its glass replacement figure is 0.
- A deer strike is paid under comprehensive on every option, so the comprehensive figures of the option are the ones that relate to it.
